description.content: Endpoints for querying Yearn vault data

item.name: Get all vaults for a chain

request.name: Get all vaults for a chain

description.content: Retrieve all vaults for a specified chain ID. Supports pagination, ordering, and filtering by strategy conditions and details. Returns vaults matching the IsYearn inclusion filter by default.

query.description: Determines the order of returned vaults.
Filters strategies based on specified condition.
Filters vaults based on migration status.
Comma-separated list of chain IDs to filter vaults.

variable.description: (Required) The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

response.name: An array of vault objects for the specified chain.
